usage: Used to describe a plant that looks strong, lively, and free from disease or damage.
Common with nouns like flowers, leaves, seedlings, and trees when talking about growth condition.
Can also be used more generally for a person or animal, so context usually tells you it is about plants here.
A very natural basic word; in gardening talk it often means the plant is in good condition and growing well.
